human_feedback: WiLoR 2D is definitely better overall than MediaPipe; handles hands entering/leaving occlusion. MediaPipe bounces even when visible.
Primary interaction part masks looked worse than original.
Kineo works when present but randomly disappears; user suspected eyes not visible.
CLIP + Drop-DTW is only okay and misses many substeps.

agent_findings.subject: Kineo NLF continuity
agent_findings.finding: Fused person crops increased NLF output from v2's 478/600 frames to 581/600: 478 native detections, 94 source-aligned and consistency-gated BoxMOT fallbacks, and 9 bounded box interpolations. The remaining 19 frames are explicitly missing in two BoxMOT/native outage intervals; no body keypoints are forward-filled.

agent_findings.subject: WiLoR temporal stabilization
agent_findings.finding: Dense raw/stabilized/fallback sheets over the requested audit ranges show the stabilized wrist/palm layer retains visible contact/re-entry alignment without a visually evident One-Euro smear. The measured wrist-step jitter reduction remains 14.0%; no additional smoothing was applied because the sheets do not establish an improvement.

agent_findings.subject: corrected SAM3 primary and contact diagnostics
agent_findings.finding: Audit sheets at the requested segmentation ranges render corrected SAM3 as the primary mask layer and retain raw geometry-only contact candidates separately. The 359 raw triggers are retained in data and condensed into 15 same-part review episodes/bookmarks.

agent_findings.subject: face-gating check
agent_findings.finding: The Kineo fusion path uses only source-aligned person boxes and NLF crop inference; it contains no face, eye, HMD, or visibility gate. The continuity change therefore does not support or depend on the eye-visibility hypothesis.

agent_findings.subject: fine substep alignment
agent_findings.finding: The checked-in 11-step agent-authored visual timeline remains the primary navigation layer. The preserved Crop-CLIP/Drop-DTW arm remains visibly labeled exploratory failure evidence (3 of 9 checkpoint matches and 158-frame mean boundary error), with no cosmetic retuning applied.
